title: Standard twist data on the transported polynomial Proj twist
statement: Let k be a field, d an integer, P=Proj k[x₀,x₁] with the standard grading [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], Q=P¹_k with its standard charts [def-sc-p1-standard], and C:P≅Q a chart-compatible isomorphism [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism]. The ordinary module pullback (C.iso.inv)^* O_P(d), namely the source library left adjoint to module pushforward (equivalently the tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]), admits TwistData of degree d: sections g₀,g₁ on U₀,U₁ freely generating on every subopen, with g₀=t^(-d)g₁ on U₀∩U₁. No other module L, isomorphism to L, or uniqueness assertion occurs.

proof.text: The private helper chart_preimage first proves that the polynomial coordinate basic opens cover Proj using iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' and MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X_eq_top. The equations C.chart_eq then identify C.iso.hom with Proj.linearProjection by linearCover.hom_ext. Proj.linearProjection_preimage_standardOpen and the inverse-isomorphism identities imply that the inverse image under C.iso.inv of D_+(x_i) equals the standard open U_i.

proof.text: The helper chart_coordinate identifies the section x_j/x_i after inverse pullback with ProjectiveSpace.coordRatio i j. Apply homOfSections_appLE_coordRatio to the linear chart, and use awayToSection_awayι_appLE and injectivity of the chart section-ring isomorphism. The equality C.chart_eq and C.iso.inv_hom_id transport this chart calculation to C.iso.inv.

proof.text: The helper polynomial_transition constructs the overlap unit c explicitly: its value is the restriction of x_i/x_j and its inverse is the restriction of x_j/x_i. Pointwise evaluation using awayToSection_apply and HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk proves their product is one. Evaluation of twistPowSection reduces x_i^d = c^d x_j^d to equality of localization fractions. Split the integer degree into ofNat and negSucc; multiply denominators and prove the resulting polynomial identity. This treats degree zero and negative degrees without extra hypotheses.

proof.text: Define g_i as the restriction of Scheme.Modules.pullbackSection C.iso.inv (twistPowSection d X_i) to U_i using chart_preimage. The existing proved source lemma Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app, followed by IsFreeGenerator.map, supplies both bijective_smul fields on every subopen. The helper transported_map_g₀ applies pullbackSection to polynomial_transition, then uses pullbackSection_map and pullbackSection_smul and restricts to the overlap. The chart_coordinate calculation identifies the image of c with ProjectiveSpace.ratio 0 1; Units.ext and map_zpow identify the image of c^d with transitionUnit d 0 1. This proves map_g₀. Assemble these sections and the three proofs into TwistData. The statement uses the ordinary Scheme.Modules.pullback, so no tensor-pullback comparison theorem is needed in this proof.
